description:
Read the stored file summary for a file session. Returns { analysis } where analysis is the summary analyze_file stored (page count, finished size, size without bleed, and the file-derived selections), or null when the file session carries no stored summary. Summaries stored before this tool read only sizes may also carry a classification and color palette.

Use this on a fresh product-page arrival to decide whether to open with a file summary and offer to match the configuration. Absence of a summary means "no analysis → start from scratch".

fileSessionId.description: File session ID to read the stored analysis from.

name: get_file_session_analysis
